description: Project-owned OpenClaw cron registry. OpenClaw cron executes these jobs; this file is the source of truth for their intended configuration.

defaults.fileReadingRule: Read batch instruction files and Korean report bodies with a platform-neutral UTF-8-safe reader, such as OpenClaw file_fetch or native workspace file access. Do not use host-default shell decoding such as Windows PowerShell 5.1 Get-Content without explicit UTF-8 handling. If Korean text appears corrupted, discard that read result and reread with a UTF-8-safe reader before composing the Discord report.

jobs.name: daily-etf-watchlist-intraday-kiwoom
jobs.description: Mon-Fri 15:10 Kiwoom intraday watchlist build + immediate LLM scoring

jobs.name: daily-close-bet-order
jobs.description: Mon-Fri 15:21 report close-bet order results after Windows scheduled task
jobs.runNote: Report-only OpenClaw cron. Do not run scripts/run_close_bet.py, do not place orders, and do not retry order execution from this cron.

jobs.name: daily-new-etf-insight-batch
jobs.description: Daily 07:00 KST previous-day new_etf_insight ETF batch and DuckDB sync

jobs.name: daily-etf-watchlist-krx-ohlcv
jobs.description: Tue-Sat 08:00 fetch previous-day KRX full-market OHLCV only; no watchlist build or LLM scoring
